summary: Frontend-only test of the offline Sono Study Expo app at a 390x844 viewport (web preview). Every requested flow works: the Home screen with 5 topic cards, overall progress, streak and a theme toggle that stays set after reload; the Topic screen's notes/mnemonics tabs, mark-as-read (topic % goes 0->2->5->2) and bookmarks; Flashcards (flip animation, Still learning/Know it moving the counter, the all/learning/new modes with correct counts 18/1/16, shuffle, bookmark, the deck-complete screen, review-learning empty state, show all); Quiz (Submit disabled until an option is picked, answers locked after submit, explanation, next, results with score and best, the missed-question list matching the wrong answers, retry, record saved to storage); the Saved tab (empty state, filter chips all/section/card/mnemonic, remove, open topic); the Progress tab (stats, per-topic bars, recent quizzes empty state, reset modal with cancel and confirm); and data kept after reload, plus dark mode on all screens. No page errors or red screen. No deprecated Expo packages and no SafeAreaView misuse found. Minor issues remain: correct quiz answers are biased toward option B, the flashcard shuffle button does not reset session counts, and white text on coral/green fails contrast.

ui_bugs.issue: The shuffle onPress resets the index but not the session counters (setSession). If you shuffle partway through, the Deck complete summary can show more known/learning cards than the deck holds. Reference: app/flashcards/[id].tsx:97-101
next() calls recordQuiz without a guard. A fast double tap on the last 'See results' could record the attempt twice (attempts and history duplicated). Reference: app/quiz/[id].tsx:48-52

design_issues.screen: Global (Home hero, Progress hero, Quiz results, primary/success buttons)
issues: White text (#FFFFFF) on brandPrimary #E07A5F and on success #4EA86A is about 2.95:1 contrast. This fails WCAG AA for normal text such as the 16px result text and 14px labels. Use a darker coral/green or dark text.

Correct answers sit at a fixed position and options are not shuffled. Of 70 questions, 43 (61%) have the answer at index 1 (B), 16 at C, 9 at A and 2 at D, so always picking B scores about 61%. Shuffle the options per question (remap the answer index).
'Open topic' on flashcard and mnemonic bookmarks opens the topic on the Notes tab, not the saved card or mnemonic (small UX gap).

action_items: Shuffle quiz options per question (and remap the answer index) to remove the bias toward B (61% of answers are B)
Reset session counts ({known:0, learning:0}) when the shuffle toggle is pressed in flashcards/[id].tsx
Guard recordQuiz against a double tap on the last 'See results' (e.g. return early if finished)
Improve contrast of white text on #E07A5F / #4EA86A (currently about 2.95:1)
Optional: when a mnemonic bookmark is opened from Saved, open the topic on the Mnemonics tab
critical_code_review_comments: progress.tsx: storage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state)) is stringified again by the storage util, so the stored value is double-encoded. It works but is redundant.
Reset also wipes bookmarks. This matches the modal text, but users may not expect it, so consider keeping bookmarks.
All files are under 220 lines, use StyleSheet via makeStyles, wrap text correctly and have testIDs on interactive elements.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass functionally; minor issues listed

seed_data_creation: None. Each test run cleared localStorage before starting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data is stored locally only (web: localStorage key sono_study_progress_v1, which is double JSON-encoded, and theme_pref). Clear localStorage before each run. Routes: /topic/{id}, /flashcards/{id}, /quiz/{id}, /bookmarks, /progress. There are several header-back-button elements in the DOM (stack), so use '>> visible=true'.
